prompt: Spring Boot Undertow access log %D response time prerequisite
answer:
For Undertow in Spring Boot, enable:

```properties
server.undertow.options.server.record-request-start-time=true
```

Then configure the access log, for example:

```properties
server.undertow.accesslog.enabled=true
server.undertow.accesslog.pattern=%t %a "%r" %s (%D ms)
```

The `record-request-start-time` server option is required for `%D` (and `%T`) to report request-processing time; otherwise, the time fields may appear as `-`.
